lessons.lesson: V11 Phase E scoring exposed that the generic 6-cell stress matrix (incl. drop_one_fold) is a SUPERSET of what frozen family folds() contracts accept. Scored drivers MUST derive the cell list per family (probe the frozen folds contract) and record exclusions in preflight. LOT/ILLIQ declare no dropped-fold cell; drop-one-fold Stage-A is NOT_APPLICABLE_FROZEN_DESIGN for them.
lessons.v12_action: A2/A4: stress cell list derived per family from frozen folds contract; unsupported cells excluded and recorded in preflight

lessons.lesson: OILEV: weekly quintile books on a DV-median-eligible 9-name universe produce 0.5..1.0 leg weights -> structurally incompatible with the frozen 0.30 adapter weight cap (52/52 stamps). The a9f '1-name/leg HIGH' flag was a true launch blocker in waiting. Future freezes must reconcile quintile breadth with the adapter cap BEFORE freezing (e.g. require >=4 names/leg at the median eligible-set size), else the family is unscoreable as frozen.
lessons.v12_action: A4: OILEV-V2 fixed diversified book (4 lowest / 4 highest, >=9 eligible, uniform scale to |w|<=0.30); 52/52 pre-window stamp feasibility gates pre-score

lessons.lesson: LOT (residual-MAX 7d, weekly): the anchor lost (PF 0.72, MDD 79%) AND the sign-inverted control WON (net +0.71, PF 1.34) -> the frozen falsification clause triggers. Literature-signed mechanisms on 2025-2026 perps can run sign-inverted; the inverted-control design did its job and converted a naive null into an honest sign finding.
lessons.v12_action: carried as falsification-design evidence: sign-inverted causal controls remain mandatory in every V12 family

lessons.lesson: Pre-score gate gap: score_valid=true on all-zero finite metrics allowed a zero-position baseline to publish (launch-1 incident). Any scored driver must gate publication on n_positions>0 and record compute-once observations for refused cells. Git Bash background job control on Windows also detaches python children - harness-tracked tasks with python -u are the reliable launcher on Windows hosts.
lessons.v12_action: A2: publication requires n_positions > 0 and at least one valid decision/fill; refused computations increment observed once; exact replay increments neither

lessons.lesson: The canonical global ledger is gitignored and machine-local; host migrations strand it. Future sprints must checksum+transfer the registry (or track a per-sprint ledger summary) as part of staging; V11 Phase E used a fresh empty-seeded V11 merge ledger with deferred historical reconciliation.
lessons.v12_action: A1/A2: portable per-sprint V12 ledger package (schema + empty-ledger hash + transfer manifest) required before scoring; host migration without it = prelaunch FAIL

lessons.lesson: ILLIQ-AMIHUD (28d formation, weekly) was a 12/13-gate near-survivor: positive expectancy, PF 1.355, 3/3 folds positive, MDD 9.2%, stress-surviving, negative causal control = real signal. It still fails the frozen fold-concentration gate (one fold = 70.6% of positive PnL > 50%). The concentration gate exists to catch fragile, single-regime edge; near-misses must be recorded as REJECT (no discretion) but flagged in the register as the strongest future re-test candidate WITH a pre-registered hypothesis for why concentration arose (regime clustering) BEFORE any future S1 plan.
lessons.v12_action: ILLIQ replication identity frozen in brief: same gates incl. 0.50 fold concentration; preregistered non-overlapping S0R window

lessons.lesson: ILLIQ drop-one-symbol was vacuous (the lexicographically-first dropped symbol held 0 positions in anchor and neighbour, so nets were identical). Drop-one diagnostics must select the dropped symbol by realized book membership (largest |weight| holder), not sorted-first, or the gate silently loses its information. Disclosed by A7; changes no V11 outcome.
lessons.v12_action: A4: drop-one-symbol must select the largest realized |weight| held symbol with deterministic tie-break; cannot choose an unheld symbol
